label: Initial API serializer interfaces
instruction: Generate api/serializers.py using DRF ModelSerializer. Maximum 80 lines. Classes LeaveApplicationSerializer, LeaveBalanceSerializer, LeaveTaskSerializer, LeavePolicySerializer, LeaveCalendarSerializer. Use the exact existing model field names. Application accepts leave_type, start_date, end_date, purpose; id,user_id,status,timestamps and followup state read only. Other serializers use fields="__all__". No service code or new models.
